title: narcissus jonquilla var. minutiflorus
intro: Narcissus jonquilla var. minutiflorus, commonly known as the Miniature Jonquil, is a fragrant and delicate variety of the Jonquil narcissus, characterized by its small white flowers and sweet, honey-like scent. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in promoting relaxation and reducing stress, which is attributed to its therapeutic actions, including its sedative and anxiolytic effects. The Miniature Jonquil is rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its health benefits, such as improving sleep quality and reducing anxiety. The health benefits of this plant are also thought to be due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
